jobs.prompt:
Implement the shared contract exactly: add and export async `cursorClaimConflicts(root, jobs)` in tools/swarm.mjs, call it from `runManifest` (refuse, before `registerLiveRun`) and from `validateProject` (warnings only), and add examples/cursor-smoke.json. Keep the runner dependency-free; follow the surrounding code style (short functions, `fail(message, code)`, field-lesson style comments only where a constraint is not obvious). Do not change any other behavior.

Write tests/cursor-claims.test.mjs with `node:test` (import './_isolate-config.mjs' first, like tests/cursor-adapter.test.mjs; copy its fixture/fakeCursor/viaFake/runEnv helpers, they are not exported). Cover: (1) no claims file: a cursor job runs to complete; (2) a claim on a job output: runManifest rejects with code cursor-claim-conflict naming the claim and file, and the spawn stub is never called and no .swarm/runs/<id> state is created; (3) a claim on an unrelated file: run completes; (4) malformed JSON and a wrong shape (e.g. files not an array) both reject with cursor-claims-invalid; (5) validateProject returns a cursor-claim-conflict warning with claim/files/jobIds and does not throw; (6) examples/cursor-smoke.json passes validateManifest, runs with the fake cursor-agent, integrates via integrateRun, and the integrated output file has the fake's content. Every test uses a fake cursor-agent; never run a real one.

Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/cursor-claims.test.mjs tests/cursor-adapter.test.mjs tests/cursor-lane-guard.test.mjs` inside your sandbox and make it pass. ignoreTests lists the many existing tests that import tools/swarm.mjs; you do not need them, but do not break exports they use.

Document the shared contract's behavior; change no code behavior. (1) docs/cursor-lane.md: say `swarm run` now refuses any job whose output is claimed in coordination/cursor-claims.json (code cursor-claim-conflict) and `validate` warns, so `check-manifest` is optional; keep the rest. (2) tools/cursor_lane_guard.py: update only the module docstring line for check-manifest to note run does this automatically; no logic change. (3) docs/manifest-reference.md: in the Board section add one short paragraph on the Cursor claims check with both codes. (4) CHANGELOG.md: add exactly one bullet at the end of the existing `## 1.52.0` section (do not add a new version heading). (5) docs/providers.md cursor section: one sentence pointing to the claims check. Plain, short sentences. Do not touch skills/project-swarm/SKILL.md or README.md. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/cursor-lane-guard.test.mjs` and any release/changelog test that reads CHANGELOG.md, and keep them passing.
